title: Extracting High Molecular Weight DNA from Halichondria panicea
author: Rasmus Dam Wollenberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yvkfw4w
materials: If A260/A230 is < 2.0, perform a clean-up step with the Qiagen PowerPro CleanUp kit.
If A260/A230 is < 2.0, perform a clean-up step with the Qiagen PowerPro CleanUp kit.

steps.title: Rinse and grind tissue
steps.instruction: Rinse the sample three times with filter‑sterilized seawater, then grind ~1 g of tissue in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle to a fine powder.

steps.title: Transfer homogenate to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized tissue into a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Add AP1 buffer and RNase
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of Buffer AP1 (QIAGEN, Germany) and 50 µL of 100 mg/mL RNase A to the tube, invert a couple of times to mix, then incubate at 65 °C for 30–60 min, inverting the tube every 5–10 min.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Cool the tube to ~50 °C, add 150 µL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K, invert gently to mix, and incubate at 50 °C for at least 2 h, inverting frequently.

steps.title: Precipitate SDS with P3 buffer
steps.instruction: Cool the sample on ice for 5–10 min, add 1 700 µL of Buffer P3 (QIAGEN, Germany), and invert gently 5–10 times to precipitate SDS and polysaccharides.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 7 200 RCF for 30 min.

steps.title: Organic extraction
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑bore tip (cut with a sterile blade), transfer the supernatant to a new 15 mL tube, add an equal volume of chloroform:phenol:isoamyl (1:1 v/v), and either vortex briefly to form an emulsion or mix gently for prolonged incubation to minimise DNA shearing.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 200 RCF for 20 min, then carefully remove the aqueous supernatant with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Repeat organic extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 7 and 8 one to two additional times, pooling the final aqueous supernatant in a clean 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add molecular‑biology‑grade 3 M sodium acetate, pH 5.2 ± 0.1 (Sigma S7899) to achieve a final concentration of 0.3 M in the solution.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add one volume of isopropanol: use room‑temperature isopropanol for HMW DNA or ice‑cold isopropanol for LMW+HMW DNA (optional overnight incubation at –20 °C). Invert a few times to mix until DNA threads appear, then centrifuge at 7 200 RCF for 10 min at room temperature (for HMW DNA).

steps.title: Ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, add enough ice‑cold 70 % ethanol to cover the pellet, invert gently, and centrifuge 10 min at 7 200 RCF. Replace the ethanol with fresh ice‑cold 70 % ethanol and repeat the centrifugation. After the final wash, remove as much liquid as possible and aspirate residual ethanol with a P10 pipette after a short spin.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet for 5–10 min, avoiding over‑drying.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100–200 µL AE buffer, then incubate at room temperature or 4 °C for at least 2 days (longer incubations of 1–2 weeks are acceptable). If the pellet does not dissolve readily, gently pull DNA threads with a P10 pipette.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop (or similar) and a Qubit dsDNA assay, and evaluate the size distribution of the extracted DNA.
